overview: Krishkar Pharmaceuticals SFA — a comprehensive Sales Force Automation platform for pharmaceutical field teams. Includes 6 role-based portals (MR, ASM, RSM, ZSM, HR, Admin) with complete field activity management, order tracking, sample management, and HR workflows.
features: Role-based portals for MR, ASM, RSM, ZSM, HR, and Admin
Daily Call Reports with GPS enforcement and auto-checkout
Monthly Tour Plan with bulk upload and station selection
Order Management with distributor tracking and credit check
E-Detailing product catalog with PDF downloads and usage metrics
Sample issuance and return tracking with compliance ledger
Visit Frequency Planner with tier-based compliance tracking
Leave management with EL, Field Leave, and full approval workflow
Official Letters with company letterhead PDF generation
Compact PDF exports with company branding across all portals
